issues.title: Middleware not integrated — cookie-to-header bridge broken
issues.description: proxy.ts exports a proxy() function for JWT cookie → x-demo-user-email bridging, but no middleware.ts at root registers it. Real auth flow is broken; only demo mode works.
issues.fix: Create middleware.ts at root that exports proxy() function

issues.title: No rate limiting on signup/login routes
issues.description: Both auth routes lack rate limiting. Brute-force and credential stuffing attacks possible.
issues.fix: Add checkRateLimit() call at start of both routes

issues.title: Collab stream endpoint accepts email via query parameter
issues.description: getSseEmail() reads email from ?email= query param, allowing impersonation of any user.
issues.fix: Remove query parameter auth; use only x-demo-user-email header

issues.title: Email not lowercased on login (but is on signup)
issues.description: Signup lowercases email, login does not. Case-sensitive mismatch can prevent login.
issues.fix: Add .toLowerCase() to email on login route

issues.title: Weak password validation (length only)
issues.description: Only checks minimum 8 characters. No complexity requirements.
issues.fix: Add complexity checks or use a validation library

issues.title: JWT 7-day expiry with no refresh mechanism
issues.description: Tokens expire after 7 days with no refresh. Long expiry + no refresh is suboptimal.
issues.fix: Implement refresh tokens or reduce expiry with sliding window

issues.title: Auth/me returns user data before checking suspension
issues.description: Full DB lookup happens before suspension check. Minor info leak.
issues.fix: Check suspension immediately after JWT verification

issues.title: No input sanitization on AI instruction field
issues.description: Instruction field validated for length but not content (prompt injection, XSS).
issues.fix: Add content sanitization

issues.title: Student-context endpoint rejects ADMIN (should allow)
issues.description: Uses requireRequestUser() then manually checks role !== 'STUDENT', blocking ADMIN. Should use requireStudentUser() which allows ADMIN bypass.
issues.fix: Change to requireStudentUser(req) or add ADMIN exception

issues.title: Grade-summary endpoint rejects ADMIN
issues.description: Same pattern as RBAC-001. ADMIN blocked from viewing student grades.
issues.fix: Use requireStudentUser() or add ADMIN exception

issues.title: User directory allows any role to search all users
issues.description: Any authenticated user can search all users via ?q=, returning email, role, department. Students can enumerate all educators/admins.
issues.fix: Implement role-appropriate scoping on user search results

issues.title: Staff pages missing client-side role enforcement
issues.description: Staff pages never check currentUser.role. API routes are protected, but page UI loads for unauthorized users.
issues.fix: Add useEffect role check with router.replace('/') redirect

issues.title: Inconsistent ADMIN bypass patterns across endpoints
issues.description: Some endpoints allow ADMIN bypass (requireStudentUser), others don't (manual role checks). Inconsistent design.
issues.fix: Standardize ADMIN bypass policy and document it

issues.title: Analytics navigation shows same link to all roles
issues.description: Analytics link marked always:true but targets different pages per role. Confusing navigation.
issues.fix: Split into role-specific navigation items

issues.title: Invalid date parsing from query parameters
issues.description: Date strings passed directly to new Date() without validation. Invalid dates create NaN silently.
issues.fix: Add date validation function that checks isNaN(d.getTime())

issues.title: User JSON force-cast with 'as unknown as' without validation
issues.description: User-controlled JSON cast to Prisma InputJsonValue without schema validation. Allows oversized/malicious payloads.
issues.fix: Validate with Zod before type coercion

issues.title: Upvote toggle uses read-then-write without transaction
issues.description: Check-then-act on upvote without transaction. Concurrent requests can create duplicate upvotes or incorrect counts.
issues.fix: Wrap in prisma.$transaction()

issues.title: JSON.parse without size limit on session notes
issues.description: JSON.parse on session.notes without checking payload size. Large payloads can exhaust memory.
issues.fix: Add size check before parsing

issues.title: Unbounded concurrent Anthropic API calls in news-fetch cron
issues.description: Up to 30 concurrent Anthropic calls per source. No backpressure or batching.
issues.fix: Implement batch processing with concurrency limit of 5

issues.title: Missing pagination bounds on multiple routes
issues.description: parseInt() on page/limit without max bounds. User can request page=999999999.
issues.fix: Add Math.min() bounds capping

issues.title: No rate limit on Sonnet-powered rubric extraction
issues.description: Rubric extraction calls Sonnet without rate limiting. Spammable for cost escalation.
issues.fix: Add checkRateLimit() before AI call

issues.title: Missing image alt text in ComposeModal and MessageInput
issues.description: User avatar img tags lack alt attributes. WCAG 2.1 Level A violation.
issues.fix: Add alt={user.name || 'User avatar'}

issues.title: Silent API failures in ChatInterface
issues.description: Async operations use .catch(() => {}) with empty handlers. Users won't know if message failed.
issues.fix: Show error toast on catch blocks

issues.title: alert() used for file upload errors
issues.description: File upload errors use browser alert() instead of toast/banner. Jarring UX.
issues.fix: Replace with toast notification

issues.title: No skeleton/placeholder during tab switch on Communications page
issues.description: Tab switch shows blank space while loading. Appears broken.
issues.fix: Add skeleton cards during load

issues.title: Petition form allows duplicate submissions
issues.description: Submit button not disabled during submission. User can multi-submit.
issues.fix: Disable button when submitting=true

issues.title: Registrar dashboard has no per-card skeletons
issues.description: Multiple parallel fetches but no loading skeleton per card. Page appears blank until all resolve.
issues.fix: Add skeleton loaders for each card independently

issues.title: Explore Majors silent failure on program load
issues.description: Program fetch has .catch(() => {}) — looks like loading forever on failure.
issues.fix: Set error state with retry button

issues.title: Missing ARIA labels on interactive elements
issues.description: Close buttons, search inputs, icon-only buttons missing aria-label attributes.
issues.fix: Add aria-label to all icon-only buttons

issues.title: Form labels not associated with inputs
issues.description: Labels lack htmlFor matching input id. Screen readers can't associate.
issues.fix: Add id to inputs and htmlFor to labels

issues.title: Missing library empty state on student homepage
issues.description: Empty library shows blank section. User thinks it's broken.
issues.fix: Show 'Add your first tool' banner when empty

issues.title: Quick Launch button hover-only, invisible on mobile
issues.description: Button only appears on hover. Mobile/keyboard users can't access it.
issues.fix: Make always visible on mobile, ensure keyboard focus

issues.title: CSV export in GradebookTab has no feedback
issues.description: Export doesn't show success/error. User doesn't know if it worked.
issues.fix: Add toast on success/error

issues.title: Policy Navigator search fails silently
issues.description: Search .catch(() => {}) hides failures. No error feedback.
issues.fix: Show error message when search fails

issues.title: Unhandled JSON.parse crash in analytics session analysis
issues.description: JSON.parse on Claude response without try/catch. Malformed AI response crashes the API.
issues.fix: Wrap in try/catch with fallback score

issues.title: Canvas API response type assertions without validation
issues.description: Response cast with 'as Array<{id: number}>' without validation. Different API shape = crash.
issues.fix: Use Zod schema validation instead of type assertions

issues.title: Community page silent fetch failure
issues.description: Silent catch block hides all errors. If API fails, page shows empty with no feedback.
issues.fix: Set error state, show error UI with retry

issues.title: Tools API unsafe 'as any[]' type assertion
issues.description: Tools result cast as any[] then .map(). If null/undefined, crashes.
issues.fix: Add null check before mapping

issues.title: 38+ fetch calls without timeout/AbortController
issues.description: Fetch calls across 30+ files have no timeout. Slow/hung APIs freeze the UI.
issues.fix: Wrap all fetch calls with AbortController (30s default)

issues.title: Multiple unguarded res.json() calls
issues.description: res.json() called without catch on success path. Non-JSON responses crash.
issues.fix: Wrap with try/catch and provide empty fallback

issues.title: Admin pages render before router.push redirect completes
issues.description: Role check calls router.push('/') but render continues before redirect. Admin UI briefly visible.
issues.fix: Return null/loading while redirecting

issues.title: Faculty analytics fetch doesn't check res.ok
issues.description: Fetch → res.json() without checking res.ok. 500 responses crash silently.
issues.fix: Check res.ok before parsing, set error state

issues.title: SpeechRecognition unsafe window cast
issues.description: (window as any).SpeechRecognition without feature detection. Missing API = crash.
issues.fix: Add proper feature detection with fallback

issues.title: Only 2 pages have error.tsx; 10+ major routes missing
issues.description: Missing error.tsx means child component throws crash entire page to white screen.
issues.fix: Create error.tsx for all major route segments

issues.title: Anthropic API calls without timeout
issues.description: AI API calls have no timeout. Slow Anthropic response hangs the request indefinitely.
issues.fix: Add timeout configuration to Anthropic client

issues.title: localStorage access could fail in private browsing
issues.description: localStorage.getItem() can fail in private browsing mode.
issues.fix: Ensure try/catch wraps entire function
